title: Normalized completed tensor and pullback under rational realization
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme, without separatedness [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] set $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(R/t^n)_X$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and $A_X=B_X[1/t]$, the sheafification of sectionwise localization. Use ordinary module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathcal C_X=D^b_c(X,R)$ for the integral constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], $Q_X:\mathcal C_X\to\mathcal R_X=D^b_c(X,E)$ for raw rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and $F_X:D(B_X)\to D(A_X)$ for $K\mapsto A_X\otimes^L_{B_X}K$. Write $J_X(Q_XK)=F_XK$, $J_X(u\otimes a)=aF_X(u)$ for the induced functor. A lisse rational object means an object of the standard heart [def-weil-constructible-heart] pro-etale locally isomorphic to a finite sum of coefficient units [def-real-rational-lisse-heart]. A finite locally free module sheaf means one pro-etale locally isomorphic to $A_X^{\oplus r}$, allowing rank zero and varying finite ranks.

Use the completed tensor and completed pullback and their raw rationalizations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For integral $M,N\in\mathcal C_X$ there is a natural isomorphism in $D(A_X)$
$$F_X(M\widehat\otimes_R^LN)\xrightarrow{\sim}F_XM\otimes^L_{A_X}F_XN.$$
It is obtained from the inverse of the specified completion map $\chi_{M,N}:M\otimes^L_{B_X}N\to M\widehat\otimes_R^LN$ [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion] and ordinary derived scalar associators. The unit comparison is the multiplication isomorphism and sends $1\otimes1$ to $1$. The rational scalar comparison sends $c\otimes(m\otimes n)$ to $(1\otimes m)\otimes(c\otimes n)$. On lisse rational inputs the displayed tensor is concentrated in degree zero and is ordinary sheaf tensor; its degree-zero map is normalized on every good integral representative as in [def-real-lisse-tensor-normalization].

Let $f:X'\to X$ be any scheme morphism between finite-type $k$-schemes, without a separatedness or $k$-linearity assumption. There is a natural isomorphism in $D(A_{X'})$
$$J_{X'}(Lf_E^*K)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{X'}\otimes^L_{f^{-1}A_X}f^{-1}(J_XK)\qquad(K\in\mathcal R_X).$$
On integral representatives it is localization of the inverse of the specified $\eta_{f,K}:B_{X'}\otimes^L_{f^{-1}B_X}f^{-1}K\to\widehat P_fK$ [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback], followed by the ordinary derived scalar-square comparison. That square carries the integral adjunction unit to the rational adjunction unit with scalar one. For lisse $K$ the right side is ordinary module inverse image in degree zero, the map sends a pulled-back basis vector to the same vector, and its degree-zero identification induces the identity on $\mathcal H^0$, as prescribed in [def-real-lisse-pullback-normalization].

proof.text: For each X choose the derived tensor calculation. Apply heart specialization to this very calculation, obtaining t and its normalization together with equality on H0 of d.raw. Assemble RealizationTensorComparison by the structure constructor, taking its derived, good-model, raw, integral and unit fields from d and its heart fields from this specialization.

For f:X to Y obtain the normalized comparison n with its integral naturality. NatIso.ofComponents produces an isomorphism after precomposition with Q. Apply unique raw-localization descent to extend it to F isomorphic to G on all rational arrows. Its component equation is exactly the integral field of RealizationPullComparison. Assemble that structure with b, n and the descended natural isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15; original tensor and pullback argument decomposed into derived calculation, heart specialization and integral pullback normalization; raw pullback descent proved by localization universal property

Step 2: F_X is the derived pullback of B_X->A_X over the identity topos; the tensor comparison is F(chi^{-1}) followed by t, matching the statement's direction, and chi is the specified natural isomorphism. Step 3 is elementary: I checked the balanced inverse scalar maps, degree-0 scalars, 1⊗1->1, and that chi's quotient coordinates and zero shifted coordinate match def-real-lisse-tensor-normalization. Step 4: finite locally free implies flat; lem-fd-ringed-flat-single-tensor-cohomology and lem-amb-derived-degree-zero-normalization put the tensor in degree 0. Steps 5-6: the two composite ringed-topos morphisms (X',A')->(X,B) have the same underlying f and the same ring map (localization of c_f); the composition and 2-isomorphism clauses of lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons identify the two sides, with unit coefficient 1 and no flat base change used. Step 7: the rational-level formulas of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom with the raw Hom⊗E of def-weil-rationalization-karoubi give naturality. Step 8: L[0] is K-flat, the counit gives the ordinary pullback, eta's explicit quotient formula sends basis to basis, and the H^0-identity requirement of def-real-lisse-pullback-normalization holds. Edge cases checked: empty schemes, rank 0, varying ranks, non-k-linear f, non-finite-type charts, torsion representatives. Batch-5 flag: lem-weil-pbc-localization-inverse-image-coherence reaches lem-trf-geometric-inverse-image-exact. Both are generic facts about any geometric morphism (inverse image is exact and commutes with localization), not part of the trace formula or Poincaré duality, so I accept the citation.
